newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends lower, Banque du Sud falls.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends lower, Banque du Sud falls.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down by 0.81 percent in lower trade after being closed on Thursday for the holiday marking the birthday of the Prophet Mohammad, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 447.80 points, down from 451.44 on Wednesday.
Total volume was 701,951 million dinars against 1.24 million dinars over the previous session.

Banque du Sud dropped 9.95 dinars, or 45 percent to 12.04 dinars with 5,300 shares changing hands on its first day of trading on the computerised system with its greater transparency, bourse sources said.
Most of the listed firms shares drop when they make the switch to electronic trading.
Since last October, the exchange has gradually introduced computerised dealing for listed firms and the system now includes 31 out of 31 shares in the index.
Arab Tunisian Bank was down 0.58 dinar to 25.4 dinars.
Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis fell 0.42 dinar to 78.58 dinars.
Union Internationale de Banques eased 0.32 dinar to 11 dinars. Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie edged lower 0.24 dinar to 40.5 dinars.

Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats d'Investissement was up 0.4 dinar to 22 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat BHH.TN rose 0.34 dinar to 15.78. Banque Nationale Agricole advanced 0.15 dinar to 18.5 dinars. Societe Tunisienne de Banque was up 0.14 dinar to 12.64 dinars.
